name: Friederike Braun-Luedicke
name_chinese: 弗雷德里克·布劳恩·卢迪基
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2016-2025); Hurun Global (2017-2026)
forbes_bio: Friederike Braun-Luedicke owns 12% of the medical device maker B. Braun Melsungen, which began in 1839 as a small pharmacy that sold herbal remedies.
Her mother's cousin Ludwig Georg Braun took the reins in 1977, when the company had just $24 million in annual sales (now around $8 billion).
Today, with 60,000 employees globally, B. Braun manufactures products ranging from infusion and injection solutions to surgical instruments.
Friederike works for B. Braun as a Manager in Personnel and Organizational Development.
forbes_facts: Friederike Braun-Luedicke is a sixth-generation family member and her mother, Barbara, is a member of the company's supervisory board.
B. Braun has been operating in Africa for more than 60 years, and now has subsidiaries in Zambia, Algeria, South Africa, Zimbabwe and Kenya.

name: Annika Bootsman Kleberg
forbes_bio: Annika Bootsman Kleberg is a Swedish shipping heir and co-owner of Soya Group, a multi-billion dollar family conglomerate.
She is the granddaughter of Olof Wallenius, who founded the group in 1934.
The family's wealth stems primarily from shipping, including a major stake in Wallenius Wilhelmsen, one of the world's largest car carriers.
The group has diversified into real estate, wind-propulsion technology, forestry and horse breeding.
She owns 50% of the Soya Group, with the remaining stake held by her brother, Jonas Kleberg.
forbes_facts: The family company is named "Soya" because the founder's first vessels in the 1930s were converted to carry soybean oil, a pioneering move at the time.
Bootsman Kleberg has a passion for reining, the dressage discipline of Western riding.

name: Peter Lim
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2008-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: After cashing out of palm oil giant Wilmar more than a decade ago, former stockbroker Peter Lim focused on healthcare, property and sports.
Lim has consolidated his healthcare businesses in Singapore and Malaysia with his Singapore-listed Thomson Medical Group.
Son Kiat serves as executive vice chairman of Thomson Medical Group. In March 2025, he was appointed president of Spanish football club Valencia, which his father acquired in 2014.
In 2023, Thomson Medical Group acquired hospital operator Far East Medical Vietnam for $353 million.
Peter ventured into education in 2022, partnering with top British boarding school Wellington College to set up international schools across Indonesia, Malaysia and Singapore in the next few years.
forbes_facts: Lim also owns Hotel Football in Manchester, located close to Old Trafford, a stadium that's the home of Manchester United.
Lim, who once made a failed bid to buy English football club Liverpool, owns a controlling stake in Spanish football club Valencia.
The son of a fishmonger, Lim held part-time jobs as a waiter and taxi driver to pay for his college tuition.

name: Kiran Kumar Jain
forbes_bio: Kiran Kumar Jain is chairman of  Chennai-based Lalithaa Jewellery, which sells gold, silver, platinum and diamond jewelry.
Wife Hemaa sits on the company's board.
Enters the ranks of global billionaires after a stellar listing of the stock on the Indian bourses at a 32% premium in August 2026.
It has 63 showrooms across south India
He started the business in 1985 using four gold bangles that his mother gave him.
forbes_facts: He is a big proponent of gold jewelry hallmarked by the Bureau of Indian Standards, which operates under the federal consumer affairs ministry.

name: Johan Lavoo
forbes_bio: Johan Lavoo is the grandson of the late Singaporean paints tycoon Goh Cheng Liang, who died in August 2025 at age 98.
The Goh family draws the bulk of its wealth from a majority stake in Japan's Nippon Paint Holdings, one of the world's largest paint manufacturers.
Johan, together with his brother and four cousins, inherited the bulk of their grandfather's fortune.
His mother is Chiat Jin, the only daughter of the late patriarch who started making paints in a small factory in Singapore before partnering with Nippon Paint in 1962.
His uncle, Hup Jin, is the chairman of Nippon Paint.

name: Li Zhongchu
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2011-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun China (2007-2026)
forbes_bio: Li Zhongchu chairs Shenzhen-listed software firm Beijing Shiji Information Technology.
He quit his first job as a government employee and started the business out of his apartment in 1998.
A Shiji service focus is hotel information management systems..

name: Dick Wolf
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Dick Wolf is best known as the creator of Law & Order, which is now the second-longest running network drama in television history, behind only its spin-off Law & Order: SVU.
.His Wolf Entertainment has had a profit participation deal with Universal Television since 2004, allowing him to retain nearly half of his shows? profits when they sell into syndication.
Wolf is one of the pioneers of the "linear binge," putting shows from a shared universe back-to-back on a single night of television
The company now oversees seven network shows and a streaming show on Amazon, producing nearly 150 episodes of television per year and overseeing more than 3,000 writers, actors and producers.
forbes_facts: Dick Wolf began his career as a copywriter, and is credited with the slogan, "You can't beat Crest for fighting cavities."
Wolf's shows have employed more than 35,000 actors, serving as the launching pad for dozens of stars including Timothee Chalamet, Adam Driver and Chadwick Boseman.

name: Brian Schimpf
forbes_bio: Brian Schimpf is cofounder and CEO of defense tech disruptor Anduril, one of the Pentagon's fastest-growing contractors.
Anduril develops a wide range of defense products, including autonomous aircraft, missiles and AI-powered command-and-control software.
Schimpf has led the company since its founding in 2017, growing it to roughly 8,000 employees and $2.2 billion in annual revenue.
Anduril was valued at $61 billion by private investors in a May 2026 funding round.
Prior to cofounding the company, Schimpf worked at Palantir as an early software engineer and later director of engineering.

name: Xiang Guangming

forbes_bio: Xiang Guangming chairs Shanghai-listed Zhejiang Weiming Environment Protection.
Weiming's main business is solid waste incineration disposal.
Xiang's wife, Wang Suqin, also holds shares in the company.

name: William Franke
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2022-2025); Hurun Global (2025-2026); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: William Franke is the chairman of low-cost carrier Frontier Airlines and the owner of air transport-focused private equity firm Indigo Partners.
Raised in Latin America, Franke attended law school at Stanford and then worked as an executive at firms including Valley National Bank and Circle K.
He first got into the airline business as the CEO of America West Airlines from 1993 to 2001, turning the company into a low-cost carrier.
He was an early investor in Ryanair; since starting Indigo Partners in 2002, he's invested in several airlines including Volaris, Wizz Air, and Spirit.
He took Frontier public in April 2021; eight months later in February 2022, the firm announced a $6.6 billion merger with its rival Spirit Airlines.
Spirit and Frontier terminated their merger agreement in July 2022, with Spirit shareholders instead agreeing to a merger with JetBlue three months later.

name: Zhu Zhaojiang

forbes_bio: Zhu Zhaojiang chairs Shenzhen Transsion, a supplier of mobile phones global emerging markets.
Transsion is headquartered in Shenzhen.
Zhu founded Transsion Technology--the predecessor of the listed company -- in 2006.

name: Mike Bingle
forbes_bio: Mike Bingle is vice-chairman of Silver Lake, a private equity firm specializing in technology investments.
Silver Lake is based in Silicon Valley and manages $43 billion.
Bingle joined Silver Lake in 2000 and within a decade became co-head of its North American operations.
Bingle has helped put together Silver Lake's investments in Virtu Financial, Ameritrade, SoFi, and Ancestry.com.
